text: The field of automation originated from the mechanical automation needs during the Industrial Revolution and has now expanded to various fields such as intelligent manufacturing, artificial intelligence, robotics, aerospace, etc. It studies how to enable equipment or systems to operate automatically according to predetermined goals without human intervention through means such as control theory, computer technology, and sensor technology. The core is the closed-loop control logic of "perception - decision - execution".This discipline combines theoretical depth and engineering practicality. It not only involves abstract theories such as mathematical modeling and control algorithms, but also covers specific applications such as robot design and industrial production line debugging. It is a core supporting discipline for "smart manufacturing" and "Industry 4.0" and other contemporary trends.
